rules.title: Public env prefix
rules.text: Expose only prefixed variables (VITE_) to client code and never put secrets in them.

rules.title: Code splitting
rules.text: Split routes and heavy modules with dynamic import.

rules.title: Path aliases
rules.text: Use configured path aliases consistently in code, tsconfig and the bundler.

rules.title: Analyze bundles
rules.text: Analyze the bundle before and after adding a large dependency.

rules.title: Hashed assets
rules.text: Emit content-hashed asset filenames for long-term caching.
